site.name: MeshTalk
site.defaultDescription: MeshTalk is peer-to-peer encrypted messaging over LAN and NAT-traversed UDP links. End-to-end encrypted, no accounts, no servers storing your data.
site.defaultKeywords: MeshTalk, peer-to-peer, encrypted messaging, E2EE, LAN chat, NAT traversal

pages.title: MeshTalk — Peer-to-Peer Encrypted Messaging
pages.description: MeshTalk sends end-to-end encrypted messages directly between devices — over your LAN or across the internet. No account, no cloud inbox, no middlemen.
pages.keywords: MeshTalk, peer-to-peer, encrypted messaging, E2EE, LAN chat, NAT traversal

pages.title: Features — MeshTalk
pages.description: End-to-end encrypted messages, named group chats, direct file transfer, terminal-native TUI and CLI, Docker support and self-updates — all peer to peer.
pages.keywords: MeshTalk features, E2EE group chat, encrypted file transfer, TUI chat, CLI messenger

pages.title: Getting Started — MeshTalk
pages.description: Install MeshTalk with one command, launch the TUI, connect on LAN, set up remote discovery, create group chats and update — step by step.
pages.keywords: MeshTalk install, MeshTalk docs, getting started, setup guide

pages.title: Privacy Policy — MeshTalk
pages.description: MeshTalk collects nothing by default. This policy covers the optional, off-by-default aggregate analytics in release builds — and nothing else.
pages.keywords: MeshTalk privacy, telemetry policy, analytics opt-in
